description: Cold boot to a running single-player adventure with a four-character party of our own ClassForge classes. Every step below was executed against the live game on 2026-08-23 and reached the loading screen for The Resistance.
produces: A live run (run.present = true) on Age of Rebellion / The Resistance, Apprentice difficulty, party of four CF_EOR_* classes.
known_issue: The game appeared to FREEZE on the adventure loading screen at the end of this sequence. The inputs themselves were correct - every step reported success and the run was created (run.present became true). Whether the freeze is the harness, the mod stack, or the game's own loading of a fresh Resistance run is UNDIAGNOSED. Investigate before relying on this recipe unattended.
safety: NEVER click 'continue-btn' or 'load-btn'. Those resume the owner's live co-op campaign.
The TEXT 'Continue' is ambiguous and appears on several unrelated buttons. Always select by the button's NAME.
The loadout confirmation's OK button is 'sys-dialog-ok-btn' in SystemDialogUIDocument - it is NOT 'continue-btn' and is safe.
notes: BOOT IS A RACE. The game reaches MAIN_MENU and then routes ITSELF to MULTIPLAYER_LOBBY roughly two seconds later, trying to rejoin a stale online adventure. Let the boot settle, then check where you actually are - do not act on the first plausible screen.
FOCUS DOES NOT PERSIST between steps. A gamepad press acts only on a focused target; pressing A with nothing focused silently does nothing. Re-establish focus immediately before each pad press.
route is an INPUT, never a post-condition. It reported MAIN_MENU while a multiplayer browser and modal were on screen. Confirm position with crucible_ui_dump.
TextSelector controls (difficulty, class) NAVIGATE - they do not respond to clicks. Focus them, then crucible_ui_nav left/right.
Difficulty is STICKY across sessions. Read it before changing it.
Buttons are never wired via Clickable.clicked in this game. crucible_ui_click's strategy 2 (Focus + NavigationSubmitEvent) is what works; strategy 3 (pointer sequence) covers the rest.

steps.why: let the boot-time auto-join finish so you escape the final state, not an intermediate one
dismiss the P0-16 online-error modal (skip if absent)
move focus from the category row down into the adventure carousel. Without this nothing is focused and the next submit hits a fallback.

step difficulty DOWN off Master. MASTER DISABLES MANUAL SAVES ('Manual Saves will not be available on Master Difficulty'), which would make fixture capture impossible. Repeat until APPRENTICE; skip entirely if already there.
FOCUS a party slot (the click itself does not fill it)
fill the focused slot. Synthetic UI events do NOT work here - the game reads its own input action. This also flips the game into controller prompts.
grab the class selector. Its text is the CLASSFORGE ID (e.g. CF_EOR_THIEF), not the display name - so a class can be chosen exactly.
cycle class; read the selector text after each press and stop at the wanted CF_EOR_* id. 'left' cycles back. Proven: CF_EOR_THIEF -> CF_EOR_TRICKSHOT.

steps.expect: party-container-next-btn enabled becomes True; the footer changes from 'Party Not Ready' to 'Loadout'
steps.status: PROVEN - four slots filled (Trickshot, Shepherd, Corsair, Bladedancer)

steps.why: start the run. NOTE: the visible text is 'Begin Adventure' but the button has NO text property - it must be selected by name.
confirm the 'unused loadout points' dialog. Appears only when loadout points are unspent.
steps.expect: run.present becomes true; adventure loading screen

verified_state_after.note: Those four members do not exist on GameRunData. v1 read them silently as null since it was written. v2 names them, which is correct behaviour, not a fault.

content_confirmed_live: class-text-selector reports CF_EOR_THIEF / CF_EOR_TRICKSHOT - our 31-class ClassForge pack is live in character creation and selectable by id.

The loadout storage lists our traits: Arcane Focus, Arcane Hunger, Arcane Memory, Battle Rhythm, Blood Price, Boss Killer, Burning Soul, Cursed Insight, Deep Thinker, Drunken Courage, Fated Wound, Field Medic.

POSSIBLE BUG: 'Field Medic' appears TWICE in the loadout list. TRAIT_CF_FIELDMEDIC is the only one of 20 EOR traits carrying a CF_ infix (every sibling is bare TRAIT_<NAME>), which is the likely cause. Confirm and fix.
next: Once in the adventure: run saveUser to capture this position as a fixture, then prove it reloads. That replaces all 18 steps with one load and is the whole point of the exercise.
Then: reach combat and assert one of our 60 recipes with crucible.state.v2.
